case_name: Ashwani Kumar vs Vijay Kumari And Others
facts_of_case: Matrimonial dispute between Vijay Kumari and Ashwani Kumar. Divorce petition filed by husband, dismissed by trial court. Wife entitled to permanent alimony of Rs.1000/- per month till life or remarriage.

legal_principles.principle: A court may vary, modify or rescind any order for permanent alimony if it is satisfied that there is a change in the circumstances of either party.
legal_principles.held: If the court is satisfied that there is a change in the circumstances of either party at any time after it has made an order under sub-section (1), it may, at the instance of either party, vary, modify or rescind any such order in such manner as the court may deem just.

legal_principles.principle: A court's order for permanent alimony is not a one-time decision, but rather an ongoing obligation that can be modified based on changed circumstances.
legal_principles.held: The parties before this Court had agreed to dissolve the marriage subject to payment of Rs.1000/- per month as permanent alimony to the wife till her remarriage or life.

outcome.final_order: Permanent alimony enhanced from Rs.1000/- to Rs.10,000/- per month in view of changed circumstances.
